same.title: No changes
same.body: Revision #{{seq}} has the same content as the deployed revision.

noRendering.title: No rendering stored
noRendering.body: Revision #{{seq}} was never rendered, so there is nothing to compare.

rendered.title: Revision #{{seq}}, rendered
rendered.helper: The compose file as it was deployed, with variables filled in and images pinned. Hidden values show as <hidden>.
rendered.label: Rendered stack, revision {{seq}}, read only

empty.title: No rendering stored
empty.body: Revision #{{seq}} was never rendered, so there is no compose file to show.

contents.helper: A roll back restores all of this exactly, including the pinned images. It never looks anything up in a registry.

source.title: Source
source.caption: Source of revision #{{seq}}
source.helper: A roll back restores this revision from what TierPlan stored. It never needs the repository.

error.body: Check the connection and try again.

gone.title: That revision is gone
gone.body: TierPlan keeps the last {{count, number}} revisions of each stack, and this one was deleted.
